retailerIdentity.scope: retailer identity display only; source IDs and source-observation counts retained

limits: Source observations are a partial roster, not a current tenant census.
Source-listed status and closure conflicts remain separate from host identity.
Ranking is a contextual editorial priority, not measured visits, sales or footfall.
Dated MLA membership does not establish current operation; existing-outlet corroboration is evidence, not another displayed/source-card count.
Owner assertions are dated owner-reported facts, not new website or field verification; identity or host confirmation alone does not establish current opening.

Linked research datasets (linkedDatasets) add branches their own sheet of record accepted as located in one registry venue; they are source listings, not field checks, and never change venue cores or primary counts.

Named-host research datasets (linkedDatasets kind named_host_listing, reviewed_candidate_host) add branches whose official source names the host — matched by the dataset's own sheet, or a candidate confirmed by scripts/review-candidate-hosts.py; they are source listings, not field checks, one item per branch (D23), and never change venue cores.
Venue core rows and aggregate store counts are not rewritten by this build.
